title.zh: Anthropic给Claude API加上运行追踪：Agent卡在哪、Token烧在哪都能查
title.en: Anthropic给Claude API加上运行追踪：Agent卡在哪、Token烧在哪都能查

current_state.zh: Anthropic launched a public beta of native OpenTelemetry tracing on the Claude Platform, letting developers route per-call latency, error, and token-usage data from the Messages API and hosted Agents into Grafana, Datadog, and Langfuse, with an optional Full content mode that logs prompts, responses, and tool inputs/outputs.
current_state.en: Anthropic launched a public beta of native OpenTelemetry tracing on the Claude Platform, letting developers route per-call latency, error, and token-usage data from the Messages API and hosted Agents into Grafana, Datadog, and Langfuse, with an optional Full content mode that logs prompts, responses, and tool inputs/outputs.
